name: The Abstract
source:
I’ve never known my own face, and the faces around me are always blurred. I thought it was harmless, even normal. My mother warned me. Today, I finally face the shadows that have always been waiting.

[From [url=https://owlgirl907.itch.io/the-abstract]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我从来不认识自己的脸，周围的脸也总是模糊的。我认为这是无害的，甚至是正常的。我妈妈警告过我。今天，我终于面对一直等待的阴影。

[来自[url=https://owlgirl907.itch.io/the-abstract]Itch.io[/url]]
